collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager afraid of chickens is handed the egg basket: ask to swap jobs, or try with a friend nearby.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is afraid of chickens. (subject.He/she) knows it makes no sense. They're small. They're mostly feathers. But they move suddenly, and they stare, and one once flew at (subject.his/her) face when (subject.he/she) was little, and (subject.he/she) has never got over it. Today the job is collecting eggs, and (friend) has just handed (subject.him/her) the basket.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Could we swap?" asks (subject). "Chickens and I don't get on." (friend) shrugs and swaps. (subject) carries water instead, which is heavier and further, and (subject.he/she) is perfectly happy about it. Nobody laughs. (friend) only says, "You'd be surprised how many people hate chickens."

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) tries. (friend) walks beside (subject.him/her), shooing. One chicken flaps its wings and (subject) jumps backwards into a bush. (friend) helps (subject.him/her) out and doesn't laugh, though it takes some effort. They get the eggs. (subject) decides that once was enough, and that is entirely fair.
